answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 1709 Country: United Kingdom Title: My mum always has dreams of dead marhoom people and then after a day or so someone passes away this has happened to me first time. Three nigts in a row i dreamt of dead people and on the 4th day as i had predicted someone i know did pass away, what does this mean? Question: My mum always has dreams of dead marhoom people and then after a day or so someone passes away this has happened to me first time. Three nigts in a row i dreamt of dead people and on the 4th day as i had predicted someone i know did pass away, what does this mean? Answer ID: 1709 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1452/1133=H) There is some laziness in isal-e-sawab (conveying the rewards of good deeds and prayers) to the dead persons. This is meaning of the dream. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
